svg.title: Lord of Pleasure: Six of Cups · Sun in Scorpio · Tiphareth (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Sun above the painting and Scorpio below, as Book T places them: "Above and below are Sun and Scorpio referring to the Decan." The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/flow-image-gen/1793159914108-ptr55tbwy5i.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0).
